notes:
Console 2.3.41. Reports now carry the term's comments, both term dates and a scanned signature.
- One remark can be typed once per term and every report in that term prints it, class teacher and head teacher both. A learner with their own comment keeps it
- The standard card now prints Term Began, the closing date and the next term's opening date. Type the dates under Academic Years, then Term dates and closing remarks
- A scanned signature picked under Staff prints above the signature line and inside the comment box, on screen and in the printout
- Placeholder content is gone from the standard report: no invented subject rows, no blank date slashes and no default motto when the school has none
- The same remarks and dates appear in the Word export
